description.text: Training Objectives This major has the basic knowledge and basic skills in basic medicine, clinical medicine and anesthesiology. It can be used in the anesthesiology, emergency department, emergency center, ICU, drug dependence abstinence and pain diagnosis and treatment in the medical and health unit from the clinical anaesthesia, first aid and resuscitation, and postoperative monitoring. Senior medical professionals who work in the regulation of physiology and physiology. Requirements 1. Master basic theories and basic knowledge of basic medicine, clinical medicine and anesthesiology; 2. Grasp the dialectical thinking and analytical methods of clinical diagnosis and treatment; 3. It has the primary ability of diagnosis and treatment of common diseases, multiple diseases and pain. It has the basic ability of common operation anesthesia, prevention and control of perioperative complications and monitoring, judgment and treatment of critical diseases; 4. The basic ability of first aid and life resuscitation; 5. Familiar with national health policy, policies and regulations; 6. Mastering the basic methods of document retrieval, data inquiry, computer application and statistical analysis, and have certain scientific research and practical working ability. Main subjects Basic Medicine, clinical medicine and anesthesiology. Main courses: human anatomy, physiology, pharmacology, internal medicine, surgery, clinical anesthesiology, emergency medicine, pain diagnosis and treatment, anesthetic pharmacology, anesthesia equipment, anesthesia physiology, anesthesia anatomy. Duration: 5 years

duration.text: The Anaesthesiology at Dalian Medical University is a 5 Years long program for international students, taught in Chinese.

fees.text: Application Fee: $ 150 USD Service Fee: $ 50 USD Tuition fee: $ 5555 USD/per year ￥ 40000 CNY/per year

materials.text: 1.Photocopy of valid passport With photo, passport number &expiration date and name included. 2.Passport-sized photo A passport-sized photo taken recently of the applicant. 3.Graducation Certificate of High school Graduation Certificate should be in English or Chinese, if not，it should be translated into English or Chinese and be notarized 4.Academic transcript of high school 5.Photocopy of 1st page to 8th page of your valid passport (Liaoning) For the regarding authority must make sure that there are at least two pages on the passport for the Chinese Embassy to stick the Visa paper and Immigration to stick the resident permit paper

requirements.text: 1.Applicant should be between 18 and 25 2.Applicant should hold high school graduation or equivalent to a Chinese high school graduate
